mapper.sql: SELECT lv.id AS layout_version_id, l.id AS layout_id, l.created_by, l.title, lv.version AS layout_version_number, lv.status AS layout_version_status, fp.width, fp.height FROM layout_versions lv JOIN layouts l ON l.id = lv.layout_id JOIN floor_plans fp ON fp.id = l.floor_plan_id WHERE lv.id = #{layoutVersionId}
mapper.select: FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.id, s.layout_version_id, s.parent_simulation_id, s.created_by, s.title, s.status, s.created_at, s.requested_at, s.started_at, s.finished_at, s.failure_message, s.failure_detail, (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM layout_search_candidates WHERE prepared_simulation_id = s.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM proposal_simulations WHERE simulation_id = s.id) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS is_improvement FROM simulations s WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT s.id, s.layout_version_id, s.parent_simulation_id, s.created_by, s.title, s.status, s.created_at, s.requested_at, s.started_at, s.finished_at, s.failure_message, s.failure_detail, (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM layout_search_candidates WHERE prepared_simulation_id = s.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM proposal_simulations WHERE simulation_id = s.id) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS is_improvement FROM simulations s WHERE s.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM simulations s
AND s.created_by = #{createdBy}
AND s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM layout_search_candidates WHERE prepared_simulation_id = s.id)

SELECT s.id, s.layout_version_id, s.parent_simulation_id, s.created_by, s.title, s.status, s.created_at, s.requested_at, s.started_at, s.finished_at, so.total_people, l.id AS layout_id, l.title AS layout_title, lv.version AS layout_version_number, sr.termination_reason, (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM layout_search_candidates WHERE prepared_simulation_id = s.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM proposal_simulations WHERE simulation_id = s.id) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS is_improvement FROM simulations s JOIN simulation_options so ON so.simulation_id = s.id JOIN layout_versions lv ON lv.id = s.layout_version_id JOIN layouts l ON l.id = lv.layout_id LEFT JOIN simulation_results sr ON sr.simulation_id = s.id WHERE s.created_by = #{createdBy} AND ( s.status IN ('REQUESTED', 'RUNNING') OR ( s.status = 'COMPLETED' AND s.finished_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE ) ) ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC

SELECT s.id, s.layout_version_id, s.parent_simulation_id, s.created_by, s.title, s.status, s.created_at, s.requested_at, s.started_at, s.finished_at, so.total_people, l.id AS layout_id, l.title AS layout_title, lv.version AS layout_version_number, sr.termination_reason, (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM layout_search_candidates WHERE prepared_simulation_id = s.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM proposal_simulations WHERE simulation_id = s.id) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS is_improvement FROM simulations s JOIN simulation_options so ON so.simulation_id = s.id JOIN layout_versions lv ON lv.id = s.layout_version_id JOIN layouts l ON l.id = lv.layout_id LEFT JOIN simulation_results sr ON sr.simulation_id = s.id WHERE s.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM simulations s WHERE s.created_by = #{createdBy} AND s.status IN ('REQUESTED', 'RUNNING')

SELECT id, simulation_id, random_seed, model_profile, routing_profile, total_people, walking_speed, reaction_time, initial_response_time_std_dev FROM simulation_options WHERE simulation_id = #{simulationId}
SELECT id, simulation_id, center_x, center_y, radius FROM hazard_zones WHERE simulation_id = #{simulationId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT layout_exit_id FROM simulation_exits WHERE simulation_id = #{simulationId} ORDER BY layout_exit_id ASC

SELECT sr.id, sr.simulation_id, sr.engine_version, sr.termination_reason, sr.frame_interval_seconds, sr.termination_detail, sr.recovery_detail, sr.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM timelines t WHERE t.simulation_result_id = sr.id) AS timeline_chunk_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM heatmaps h WHERE h.simulation_result_id = sr.id) AS heatmap_chunk_count, COALESCE( (SELECT CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.frame_data, '$.schemaVersion')) AS UNSIGNED) FROM timelines t WHERE t.simulation_result_id = sr.id ORDER BY t.chunk_sequence LIMIT 1), 0 ) AS timeline_schema_version FROM simulation_results sr WHERE sr.simulation_id = #{simulationId}
SELECT id, simulation_result_id, unit, metric_type, metric_value FROM simulation_metrics WHERE simulation_result_id = #{simulationResultId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO simulations (layout_version_id, parent_simulation_id, created_by, title, status) VALUES (#{layoutVersionId}, #{parentSimulationId}, #{createdBy}, #{title}, #{status})

INSERT INTO simulation_options (simulation_id, random_seed, model_profile, routing_profile, total_people, walking_speed, reaction_time, initial_response_time_std_dev) VALUES (#{simulationId}, #{randomSeed}, #{modelProfile}, #{routingProfile}, #{totalPeople}, #{walkingSpeed}, #{reactionTime}, #{initialResponseTimeStdDev})
INSERT INTO simulation_initial_states (simulation_id, agent_positions) VALUES (#{simulationId}, CAST(#{agentPositions} AS JSON))

INSERT INTO hazard_zones (simulation_id, center_x, center_y, radius) VALUES
(#{hazard.simulationId}, #{hazard.centerX}, #{hazard.centerY}, #{hazard.radius})

INSERT INTO simulation_exits (simulation_id, layout_exit_id, layout_version_id) VALUES
(#{simulationId}, #{layoutExitId}, #{layoutVersionId})
mapper.update: UPDATE layout_versions SET status = '잠금' WHERE id = #{layoutVersionId} AND status = '초안'
UPDATE layout_versions SET status = '초안' WHERE id = #{layoutVersionId} AND status = '잠금' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM simulations WHERE layout_version_id = #{layoutVersionId}) = 0

UPDATE simulations SET status = 'REQUESTED', requested_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, failure_message = NULL, failure_detail = NULL WHERE id = #{simulationId} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')
UPDATE simulations SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{simulationId} AND status = 'REQUESTED'
UPDATE simulations SET status = 'COMPLETED', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), failure_message = NULL, failure_detail = NULL WHERE id = #{simulationId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE simulations SET status = 'FAILED', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), failure_message = #{message}, failure_detail = CASE WHEN #{detail} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(#{detail} AS JSON) END WHERE id = #{simulationId} AND status IN ('REQUESTED', 'RUNNING')
UPDATE simulations SET status = 'CANCELLED', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), failure_message = NULL WHERE id = #{simulationId} AND status IN ('REQUESTED', 'RUNNING')
UPDATE simulations SET status = 'FAILED', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), failure_message = #{message}, failure_detail = NULL WHERE status IN ('REQUESTED', 'RUNNING')
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO simulation_results (simulation_id, engine_version, termination_reason, frame_interval_seconds, termination_detail, recovery_detail) VALUES (#{simulationId}, #{engineVersion}, #{terminationReason}, #{frameIntervalSeconds},
CAST(#{terminationDetail} AS JSON) NULL ,
CAST(#{recoveryDetail} AS JSON) NULL )

INSERT INTO simulation_metrics (simulation_result_id, unit, metric_type, metric_value) VALUES
(#{metric.simulationResultId}, #{metric.unit}, #{metric.metricType}, #{metric.metricValue})
INSERT INTO timelines (simulation_result_id, chunk_sequence, frame_data) VALUES (#{simulationResultId}, #{chunkSequence}, CAST(#{frameData} AS JSON))
INSERT INTO heatmaps (simulation_result_id, chunk_sequence, density_data) VALUES (#{simulationResultId}, #{chunkSequence}, CAST(#{densityData} AS JSON))

INSERT INTO detected_bottlenecks (simulation_result_id, bottleneck_order, start_time_seconds, end_time_seconds, peak_density, threshold_value, geometry, analysis_version) VALUES
(#{simulationResultId}, #{bottleneck.order}, #{bottleneck.startTimeSeconds}, #{bottleneck.endTimeSeconds}, #{bottleneck.peakDensity}, #{bottleneck.thresholdValue}, JSON_OBJECT( 'type', #{bottleneck.geometry.type}, 'name', #{bottleneck.geometry.name}, 'x', #{bottleneck.geometry.x}, 'y', #{bottleneck.geometry.y}, 'width', #{bottleneck.geometry.width}, 'height', #{bottleneck.geometry.height} ), #{bottleneck.analysisVersion})
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM improvement_proposals WHERE source_simulation_id = #{simulationId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM layout_searches WHERE baseline_simulation_id = #{simulationId})
